verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that answers based on your notes, plans multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve. AI Chats let you pass specific blocks or notes as context, and all AI features are opt-in, so no space data reaches third-party AI services unless you activate it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of summarization and drafting, finer-grained controls over which data the assistant can access beyond opt-in and passing context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
